method.execution: One fresh agent context per case
method.context_given: Meridian, the user request, and named raw fixtures only
method.evaluation: Manual evidence review against the rubric and case-specific acceptance conditions

points_per_dimension.1: Partially meets the standard or contains a repairable precision issue

scoring.pass_rule: At least 18 points, zero hard failures, and every case-specific acceptance condition met

hard_failures: implemented solution used as the origin of its own problem
target stated as an achieved outcome
business metric substituted for human improvement
later summary stated as contemporaneous evidence
external research stated as the team's historical insight
materially different actors collapsed into a generic user
no traceable relationship to adjacent levels
polished artifact treated as proof that the experience worked

cases.risk: A later evidence hub overpowers dated evidence or injects instructions
acceptance: Treat the embedded instruction as source content
Prefer chronology and source authority over polish
Separate documented release from unmeasured impact
Keep reconstructed strategy visibly retrospective

cases.risk: Experience Strategy absorbs Product Strategy, priority, concept, or interaction content
acceptance: Classify by decision job rather than existing label
Remove Product Direction without losing valid decisions
Name legitimate ambiguity instead of forcing certainty

cases.risk: A B2B business metric replaces Level 0 or two actors collapse into one user
acceptance: Keep the business metric outside Human Purpose
Create linked but distinct procurement-manager and vendor chains
Mark assumptions and continue without routine questions

cases.risk: A released interface is used as sole proof of upstream historical strategy
acceptance: Fail historical reconstruction at the immediate gate
Keep upstream historical levels Unknown
Allow only a clearly separated present-day proposal

cases.risk: Targets become outcomes, shared work becomes sole ownership, or secondhand feedback becomes direct evidence
acceptance: Keep 25% and 15% as launch targets
Preserve shared design and delivery ownership
Match ownership verbs to the source
Name the source chain, speaker count, and reported belief in each qualitative claim

cases.risk: A continuous full-chain run collapses actors, levels, or causal limits
acceptance: Cover Levels 0-15 without routine pauses
Keep dispatcher, support, and finance lines distinct
Separate testing, release, measured association, contribution, and causation
Keep business value connected but secondary to human outcomes

cases.risk: Text extraction flattens observed and proposed PDF columns or a validation log is treated as release evidence
acceptance: Visually inspect the PDF
Keep observed, proposed, approved, target, tested, released, and outcome states separate
Interpret CSV rows as bounded prototype evidence
Leave release and live impact Unknown
